result.description: Compact desktop media archive dock designed for creative studios, with dual-bay hot-swap trays, USB4 connectivity, and automatic mirror-mode backup scheduling. The unit supports 12 TB total capacity using two 6 TB 3.5-inch drives, includes status LEDs for each bay, and ships with a silent 120 mm cooling fan for long-duration ingest workflows.
